facts.fact: 任务组飞机配置豪华——Gibbons 早年穿越做的「战略投资」是资金来源（Ben 听出讽刺）。
facts.anchor: “One of the first things we had Gibbons do was travel back a few years and make some strategic investments.

facts.fact: 上机先签合同：保密条款+死了不告政府；六小时 Quantico 速成训练（格斗+激光枪靶）。
facts.anchor: how you won’t divulge any classified information—which includes everything about this task force and mission—and won’t sue us if you get killed.

facts.fact: 烟盒/手包藏手机：指纹解锁、当充电器、一周不开即自毁——防污染技术史。
facts.anchor: “They’ll act as battery chargers so you’ll be able to use the camera for gathering evidence

facts.fact: 1928 落地即被女仆撞见，Ben 谎称 Mr. Johnson 等 McCann；报童报纸确认 7 月 25 日。
facts.anchor: “We were shown in over half an hour ago,” Ben replies. “We’ve been waiting for Mr. McCann.”

facts.fact: William 之子 Quinten Allen 登场：Clara 从未见过此人，却「认得」他的轻抚、牵手、怀抱的力度——熟悉感远超对 William。
facts.anchor: Only now, I recognize it’s this man’s gentle touch that I know.

facts.fact: Ben 向 William 坦白全部真相：不是私奔，是回到了自己的时代；Clara 能控制传送门。
facts.anchor: Clara arrived at The Villa in 1901 the same way, and shortly after she arrived, we discovered she can control the portal.

facts.fact: Miss Swanson 之谜解开：Ben 对她说过同样的穿越真相——她不信且四处乱说。
facts.anchor: “I told her the same story I just told you. That’s the reason she said what she did about me. I thought I could trust her.”

facts.fact: 圆舞曲循环：William 用 Clara 喜爱的《睡美人》圆舞曲 woo 到了 Isabelle——Clara 在 1901 的喜好成了 1928 的姻缘。
facts.anchor: “Your fondness for the piece gave me the idea to woo my dear Isabelle with it

facts.fact: 与 Quint 起舞时 Clara 又 whisper「I know you」——这次 Disney 歌词勾起的不是母亲，而是怀中之人。
facts.anchor: “I know you,” I whisper in a singsong voice to myself

facts.fact: Quint whisper「How strange」——他似乎也在经历同样的「记忆」，Clara 不敢问。
Ben 的触碰不再像 1901 那样让她安定——这个变化比熟悉感本身更让她害怕。
facts.anchor: So often in 1901 his touch grounded me, but it has little effect now, which scares me more.

facts.fact: 章末：Quint 的目光如火——Clara 换睡衣时竟去检查裙子有没有被烧焦。
facts.anchor: so intense that when I undress in my room and change into a borrowed nightgown from Mrs. Allen, I check to make sure my dress isn’t singed.
